title: Probabilistic Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Sparse Historical Data: A Framework Integrating Bayesian Inference, Causal Models, and Game-Theoretic Allocation
reasoning: The paper uses 'fairness' and 'fair allocation' in a strictly mathematical and game-theoretic sense (specifically referencing Shapley value axioms) to model historical resource distribution. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical systems.
